subject: general
question:
Six boys P, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting in a row facing towards north (not necessarily in the same order). Q is second to the right of S. P is fourth to the left of U. U is not sitting on the extreme ends of the row. R is second to the right of Q.

Who is sitting second to the right of P?
solution:
Total boys are 6 as P, Q, R, S, T, and U.

Q is second to the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d2c064658f2890b7d17a153c9b9e6facc22633cc138c089010ed1c5b4b5732f.png] 

R is the second right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07dcf4029474b57c2b7d909497c46490a8c00780fda80f893a7c1627aab0e528.png] 

Now combining both statements-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32634024050f0c0d975554b5407ac16d4a6dfba51ca967e00caa8e5e0a65fe52.png] 

 

P is fourth to the left of U. U is not sitting on the extreme ends of the row i.e. U should be placed between Q and R than only we can arrange P as 4th left of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4f5b7ca2959a0d9847c86603fe040d711ae5ef1428deace9b2d6a5410e1a7d5.png] 

Now Blank placed will be with boy T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/742a63e393b93d80934c795d64e7f0f74c207f9d085b40b3a3cb1cd661f706e6.png] 

T is sitting second to the right of P.

Hence, **Option (2)** is correct.
